summary: Public half of the CI evidence signing key (fleet/ci) in .st/evidence-keys; inert until a signing job exists

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The key is a trust input for the evidence verifier and skip gate, but no workflow on main references the evidence-signing environment or its secret, so nothing can sign with it until a producer lands.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. One new data file, .st/evidence-keys, with one allowed_signers line.

manual.detail: No manual step. The private half exists only as the GitHub environment secret EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY.

recovery.detail: Revoke by deleting the environment secret and removing the line in a reviewed pull request.
